text:
elaine: FYI - overnight vendor auth throttles in us-west2 caused model-registry reads to pile up and produced a short 5xx spike for hosted inference. starting an action tracker thread for follow-ups.

sam: timeline and customer impact? any Dedicated tenants affected?

elaine: summary: ~3% 5xx for ~40m, latency blips for four Dedicated tenants, no data loss. chain: vendor returned 429s on token introspects -> registry client retried aggressively -> downstream timeouts.

priya: vendor acknowledges an accidental rate-limit policy push. they say it was a rollout config issue; we need written RCA.

jon: traces match prior "token-throttle" patterns we've tracked. this is recurring - treat as an incident class.

marta: logged customer impact and opened VND ticket. prepping comms.

elaine: Proposed remediation slate (owners + timelines):
- Hotfix (P0): increase local token cache TTL 30s->5m and add jittered exponential backoff on introspect retries. Owner: priya. Target: EOD+1.
- Short-term (P1): token circuit-breaker (fast-fail) + metrics for circuit trips. Owner: sam. Target: 2w.
- Fallback (P1): feature-flagged auth proxy that serves ephemeral tokens when vendor degraded; prototype + security review. Owner: sam + devsec. Target: 3w.
- Vendor (P0): demand SLA credit, dedicated auth key, and formal postmortem. Owner: marta. Target: 72h.
- Runbooks (P1): detection rules for auth-429 bursts, synthetic canary that injects controlled 429s in staging, and a mitigation checklist. Owner: jon. Target: 5d.
- Governance (P2): add this recurrence to the resilience board and a 6-month rotation for postmortem ownership. Owner: elaine. Target: next resilience meeting.

priya: taking hotfix. will open PR to bump cache TTL and add jittered backoff + cache-hit metric. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

sam: will design circuit-breaker and prototype fallback proxy options (local minting via KMS vs vendor backup key). will work with devsec on threat model. ETA: 2w design, 3w canary.

devsec: prefer ephemeral signing over static tokens; will support proxy threat model review.

jon: will add detection rules and a staging canary job to simulate throttling. will also update runbook with auto-mitigation steps. ETA: 5 days.

marta: vendor ticket updated (#VND-1830); requesting quota correction and postmortem. drafting CS comms template.

ops-bot: created tracker INC-2301: https://tracker.internal/INC-2301 (items: TOKEN-710, CB-711, PROXY-712, VND-1830, RUN-713).

elaine: scheduling short weekly resilience check-ins for 4 weeks then move to monthly. @sam please schedule and include eng-sre, eng-platform, infra, devsec, and customer-success. reconvene Friday EOD for status.

priya: ack, starting work on PR.

sam: ack, will send invites and start design.

jon: ack, will draft runbook edits.

marta: ack, monitoring vendor response.

devsec: ack, ready to review proxy design.

elaine: closing thread for now. we'll update INC-2301 as items progress and reopen if vendor response or blockers arise. thanks all :thumbsup:
